name: Math Monsters
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Monsters is a fun math game for you to play! This monster loves to eat junk food, and he is super hungry! Ted, Sandy, Bill, and Gary are the monsters available for you to play. They are hungry for candy, popsicles, and delicious cupcakes. However, people keep tossing shoes at them that are gross! Even monsters have standards! Avoid shoes as much as you can to level up and get the highest score possible. Once you play a level, it is time for math practice. Choose from various grades and subjects available for you to practice. Practice your geometry, decimals, multiplication, and fractions while enjoying a fun break in between. You can change your skill during the game if you already mastered the one you were practicing before.
